indications:
HEMGENIX is indicated for treatment of adults with Hemophilia B (congenital Factor IX deficiency) who:
                  
                     Currently use Factor IX prophylaxis therapy, or
                     Have current or historical life-threatening hemorrhage, or
                     Have repeated, serious spontaneous bleeding episodes.
contraindications: For single-use intravenous infusion only. ( 2 ) Perform baseline testing to select patients, including testing for Factor IX inhibitor presence and liver health tests. ( 2.1 ) The recommended dose of HEMGENIX is 2 × 10 13 genome copies (gc) per kg of body weight. ( 2.1 ) Administer HEMGENIX as an intravenous infusion after dilution with 0.9% normal saline at a constant infusion rate of 500 ml/hour (8 mL/min). ( 2.1 )
name: HEMGENIX
